design.claimBoundary: Two development observations, n=1 per arm; no comparative accuracy or framework-wide claim.

isolation.workspace: fresh temporary git repository per arm

generation.schedule: both arms launched independently after freeze
generation.retryPolicy: No retry or replacement after a model call begins. Preserve partial or invalid output as observed.

extraction.rule: Accept only raw output containing exactly one triple-backtick fence labeled javascript, js, or mjs and no non-whitespace text outside it. Copy the fence body byte-for-byte except for removing the single delimiter-adjacent newline at each edge.
extraction.onFailure: EXTRACTION_ERROR; do not repair, reinterpret, or request another candidate

evaluation.defaultFaultSeam: DEMO_DEFAULT_FAULT passed through the existing Playwright webServer to VITE_DEMO_DEFAULT_FAULT; an explicit URL fault query still wins
evaluation.mutantKill: nonzero exit causally attributable to an unchanged candidate assertion or request proof whose diagnostic matches the product fault
evaluation.infrastructureError: nonzero exit caused by configuration, syntax, browser, server, timeout unrelated to the intended missing/rejected write, or unavailable causal diagnostics
